teenKit.tldr: In 2026, a single dispensary can sit on a federal constitutional fault line where medical cannabis is reclassified to Schedule III while recreational cannabis remains trapped in Schedule I, triggering a brutal tax guillotine and a race of rival psychedelic therapeutics.
teenKit.whyItMatters: This strange legal and chemical collision directly dictates how billions of dollars in taxes are paid, how life-changing mental health treatments are regulated, and whether patients can legally access breakthrough medicines.
keyTakeaways: A single dispensary floor can divide two federal legal universes: medical cannabis sitting in Schedule III and adult-use retail trapped in Schedule I.
IRS Section 280E imposes an over 100% tax rate on Schedule I businesses by blocking standard deductions, creating a massive financial penalty for recreational sellers compared to medical ones.
